_comment: Deck-conditioning sweep. Mirror match, Qwen3-4B, temperature 1.0, append-only. Deck from mage-bench sample-decks 'Decks to Beat' -- ships with XMage so every card is guaranteed implemented; deckType Freeform because Freeform.java validates size only. Seat name kept short on purpose: server_config.xml maxUserNameLength=14 and the fan-out appends a numeric suffix, so a longer name fails login and burns a 120s bridge timeout. CONTROL: base notalk-strategy prompt. MUST run with MAGEBENCH_DECISION_REMINDERS=0 -- the reminder code is in the tree and fires by default, so a control collected without it is a reminder arm wearing a control's name and looks entirely normal in the output.
